ns2:section.sectionText: 4 hours A foundational course in practical data analytics for the beginner. Students will be introduced to current data analysis tools and techniques for the querying, transformation, summarization, visualization, and modeling of data. Concurrently, the course will explore the terminology and theory behind data analysis and delve into the soft skills required to become an analytics advocate in the workplace. Tools used will include R, MySQL, and Tableau. No prior experience is assumed. All other students need department approval. Email ischool-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
